# telnyx_terms_of_service_info (Data Source)

The Terms of Service the account can agree to.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `product_type` (String) Optional product filter. Omit to return info for all products. One of `branded_calling`, `number_reputation`.

### Read-Only

- `agreements` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agreements))

<a id="nestedatt--agreements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agreements`

Read-Only:

- `current_version` (String) The latest published version of these terms.
- `description` (String) A short summary of the product these terms cover.
- `effective_date` (String) The date this version took effect.
- `product_type` (String) Telnyx product the Terms of Service apply to.
- `terms_url` (String) A link to the full terms text.
